deviations.what: two members and one control newer than UI5 1.71 are kept 1:1 because they ARE the sample: sap.m.BadgeCustomData (control since 1.80, the badge marker in every customData aggregation - declared by policy, the property gate does not resolve it) and sap.m.IconTabFilter.items (since 1.77, the nested sub-tabs of iconTabBar8). The app needs a UI5 release >= 1.80.

onInit adds 30 IconTabFilters to iconTabBar0 imperatively (text 'Tab n', key n, a Text 'Content n', and a BadgeCustomData visible on the 19th). The port builds that as a bound aggregation over T_TABS with one template - so exactly one IconTabFilter, one Text and one BadgeCustomData more than the original view.xml carries, which is the template itself; the 30 instances come from the model, as they come from the loop in the original.

onTabDensityModeSelect loops over all nine bars and calls setTabDensityMode(selectedButton.getText()). tabDensityMode is a bindable property, so every IconTabBar binds the one field TAB_DENSITY (added attribute, no structural diff) and only the RadioButtonGroup round-trips: its selectedIndex is bound two-way and the three values are derived server-side, per the prefer-a-bindable-property rule (linter rule settable-property-via-action).

enableTabReordering stays true, 1:1 with the original, but a reorder no longer survives a round trip. The original adds the 30 filters imperatively, so the aggregation is unbound and IconTabBarDragAndDropUtil's removeAggregation/insertAggregation is permanent; the port binds items to the model (the 30 instances come from one template), and IconTabBar forwards that binding to its header, so the next model push re-assigns the contexts positionally and the tabs snap back. The app's one round-trip is the density RadioButtonGroup, so the sequence reorder-then-change-density loses the order. Recorded 2026-08-23.
